title: A-series and retrieval architecture review
summary: Claude issued conditional package decisions while preserving provider, credential, ownership, semantic-artifact, and load-test gates.
evidence: T-040 and T-041 received GO with additional acceptance tests and Cole-owned configuration dependencies.
T-042 remains NO-GO pending provider policy and explicit file ownership.
T-043 received GO to build and HOLD to run pending numeric targets and a load-test spend cap.
T-037, T-038, and T-039 are architecture-approved but remain gated.
T-039 no longer depends on T-037 and must route its model call through the A3 queue.
embed.js and query.js seams must be assigned in OWNERSHIP.md before T-037, T-039, or T-042 starts.
limitations: No newly reviewed package is authorized to start until its listed dependencies and Cole decisions are satisfied.
